$comment: S-106: the legal document registry. Every legal text Northline shows, with its versions (newest last), effective dates and counsel's sign-off. kind 'page' and 'file' are hashed (registry.mjs: SHA-256 of the visible text / canonical JSON) and legal.test.mjs fails when the text changes without a new version here. kind 'code' is versioned where it lives and pinned by its own test (pinnedBy). A sign-off is {counsel, firm, date, sha256 (= the version's sha256, the exact text reviewed), reference}. Process: docs/compliance/legal/review-packet.md.
